tagline: An experienced developer who isn't afraid of AI.
intro:
I build web applications with Angular, NestJS and TypeScript – and I’ve worked with AI in practice: data extraction tools for games, audio quality analysis for telephony and document analysis with the open-source Tesseract OCR engine.

I’m a dedicated software developer who loves a good challenge. I see complex problems as the perfect opportunity to build creative solutions, often using new and emerging technologies.

From concept to launch, I’ve delivered user-focused software both independently and in agile teams. I’m excited to bring my pragmatic approach to problem-solving, technical versatility, and UI/UX awareness to a team creating innovative software solutions.
